description: This file defines a React component 'CardDetailContents' for rendering and managing content blocks within a card detail view, including drag-and-drop reordering, adding text blocks, and onboarding tour steps.

methods.name: addTextBlock
methods.description: Asynchronously creates and inserts a new text block into a card, updating the content order.

methods.name: moveBlock
methods.description: Rearranges content blocks within a card based on drag-and-drop actions, updating the content order with undo support.
